mechanicTruth: Tire rubber compounded for summer stiffens as the pavement drops under about 40 degrees, so the tread stops conforming to the road and grip falls off even with plenty of tread depth left; the same cold cuts the current a battery can deliver, which is why a weak one quits on a winter morning instead of in July.
